chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from Aban, from al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in the dung of donkeys, and wash their urine.

key_terms.أَبْوَالَهَا: their urine; the substance that must be washed
key_terms.اغْسِلْ: wash; an imperative indicating cleansing is required
key_terms.الْحَمِيرِ: donkeys; the animal category being discussed
key_terms.رَوْثِ: dung; the excrement referred to in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the dung and urine of donkeys in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning taharah and najasah related to donkeys. It indicates that the dung of donkeys is not treated as problematic here, while their urine is to be washed away.
